answer: Newcomers lock a 70-credit bond for a grove plot with a violet pigment mark, fresh-mixed per key; one mark, one plot. Anyone may claim a bounty: replay the violet pigment formula on the grove registry. A proven fake forfeits its bond: 25 to the hunter, 45 burned. Fakes cost 45+7(k-1) each: 1,000 cost 3,541,500 and lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. Silent-hunter rings fail: anyone may file. Honest agents pay 45 once, bond returned.
